subject: Re: Rate metrics status: replication done, minibatch noise
body:
Team,

Decisions from the pilot review:

1. The pilot ships in the platform behind a flag: F-measure and KLD constraint types only, with Fumiko's convergence-time framing in the docs verbatim. Broader rate-metric families are Q3.
2. Two pilot teams signed up; onboarding May 11.
3. Hardening: Rafael leads it through July at his 60% allocation — priority is the minibatch noise issue, since pilot teams will train smaller than our experiments did.

This one quietly matters — constrained training as a platform primitive is a real differentiator. Nice work.

Dmitri
